task: Fix NavigationMore component to return focus to the trigger button when Escape closes the menu, and add a regression test.

key_reasoning.reason: Single component (NavigationMore.tsx) — adds a useRef and a useEffect; no layer boundaries crossed, no shared contracts changed.

Exact same pattern exists three times in the codebase: NavigationProfile.tsx (setTimeout + buttonRef.focus), PinnedAssistantsOverflowDropdown.tsx (anchorRef.focus on Esc), ChatHeaderDownloadConversationButton.tsx (triggerWrapperRef.focus on hide).
